Subject: Marketplace intake — HyperGrid listing (branding + SLA artifacts)

Hi Camila,

Thanks for submitting HyperGrid for AWS & GCP listing. Before we can move the listing into preflight, we need a couple of items clarified and a short set of evidence files: 

1) Branding/marketing copy that will appear on the marketplace tile and the product detail page (logo assets, allowed mark usage, short description).
2) Exact support SLA matrix (response times by severity, escalation contacts, on-call coverage by region).
3) Any third-party logos or co-sell claims (e.g., "validated with AWS Gateway") — please provide proof or partnership letters.

Attachments we were sent (for our records): redwood-product-sheet.pdf (overview), sla-matrix.xlsx (initial). We still need the updated brand guide and a signed support commitment template.

Can you get the finalized branding file + signed SLA doc by EOD Friday 16 Apr? If you need an extension we can push review to next week, but note that listings with unresolved SLA language cannot use the "24/7 premium support" claim. Also include a point of contact for post-listing co-sell coordination.

Next steps we will take once we have files: legal will validate claims, security will confirm no restricted logos, and marketplace publishing will schedule the preflight window.

Thanks,
Aaron Miller
Marketplace Ops — AWS Partner Network

Hi Aaron / Susan,

Appreciate the checklist — attaching the materials you requested. Short summary below and quick asks inside.

Attachments (attached to this reply): brand-guide-v3.pdf (approved branding with tile mockups), redwood-product-sheet.pdf (updated bullets), sla-matrix.xlsx (filled with response / resolution windows), redlines_sla_comments.docx (internal notes).

Key notes: 
- Branding: HyperGrid requests the "Powered by Redwood" co-marketing lockup on the listing tile. We've included two logo variants (full-color and monochrome) in the brand guide.
- SLA: HyperGrid's target commit is P1 response <= 1 hour, P2 <= 4 hours, P3 <= 24 hours. The sla-matrix.xlsx includes regional coverage (NA/EU/APAC) and an escalation ladder with on-call emails.
- Claims: HyperGrid referenced an "AWS Reference Architecture" in the product description — they have a partner reference ID but do not have an official "AWS Validated" badge. We flagged that in redlines_sla_comments.docx.

Requests from our side: 
1) Please confirm whether the "Powered by Redwood" co-marketing lockup is acceptable under AWS marketplace logo policy.
2) If the "AWS Reference Architecture" wording is not allowed, advise specific language we should use instead (we can swap to "architecture validated with partner guidance").
3) If legal needs a signed SLA template, point us to the correct DocuSign template (we included an internal draft link).

If it's easier, happy to hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow morning to walk through the artifacts — suggest 9:30am PT.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Hi Camila / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for providing the attachments — we've completed an initial intake review. A few items and next steps below: 

1) Branding: The "Powered by Redwood" lockup is permitted on the product detail page. It is not allowed on the marketplace tile with the AWS logo; please remove the AWS logo from the tile mock. We will accept the monochrome variant for the tile.

2) SLA: Your P1/P2/P3 targets are acceptable. Please add the fallback phone/pager contact for P1 outside business hours to sla-matrix.xlsx and re-upload. Once updated, Legal will need to sign the standard marketplace SLA template.

3) Claims wording: We cannot include "AWS Reference Architecture" as a claim unless HyperGrid has an AWS validated architecture badge. Please change the wording to: "architecture reviewed with partner guidance".

4) DocuSign: I've started the listing approval envelope for HyperGrid (DocuSign ID: 9f8b-Listing-432). Please have an authorized signer from HyperGrid complete the signature. Link: https://app.docusign.com/templates/XYZ-Listing-Approval

Next step: Camila, once you upload the updated sla-matrix and revised tile mock (no AWS mark), we will schedule the preflight publish window for the week of Apr 26. Reach out if you want to discuss on a quick call — I can do 9:30am PT today.

Best,
